sourceNotice: Derived from AIP Japan (AIRAC 1 Nov 2026), may not be current, edited by the Horus project and not government-made.

package.sourceKind: Official AIP Japan instrument SID/STAR charts from the SWIM AIP viewer, AIRAC 1 Nov 2026 issue.
package.headingNote: Coding tables publish both magnetic course and true course in parentheses, with magnetic variation -7.9. This extract keeps both values as printed. Horus headings are a geodetic/true frame; do not apply magnetic variation to simulator headings.
package.altitudeNotation: Bare altitude = AT (matches narrative 'at'). Prefix + = at or above. Prefix - = at or below. FL150 is stored as a flight level, not converted to feet in this file.

uncertain.reason: The speed column is an unsigned number. Hold tables use a minus prefix (at or below). Restriction type is not inferred.

uncertain.items: A / K / C variants versus 34L versus 34R
uncertain.reason: Every STAR coding page is headed RNAV STAR RWY34R/34L. A tighter one-runway mapping is not printed on the extracted pages.

uncertain.items: STAR and VAMOS page footers EFF 31 OCT 2024; VISIP footer EFF 2 OCT 2025
uncertain.reason: The PDFs were taken from the AIP Japan issue labelled AIRAC 1 Nov 2026. Footer dates record when that plate was last marked effective; they are older than the package date when the plate was not reissued.

uncertain.items: VISIP ONE narrative and TTE coordinates
uncertain.reason: The official PDF text stream uses a non-standard encoding for the procedure paragraphs and the TTE coordinate line. Narrative and TTE DMS were decoded and marked uncertain. VISIP itself has no published lat/lon (only D28.1 TTE); none is invented.

uncertain.items: VISIP HDG and TTE radial values
uncertain.reason: Recorded as printed. The recoverable text does not restate magnetic versus true; values are not converted.

procedures.name: VISIP ONE DEPARTURE
notes: Conventional SID. No ARINC-style coding table and no VISIP coordinate table on the chart.

Narrative recovered from a non-standard PDF text encoding on the official chart; wording below was cross-checked against the decoded heading/radial tokens (HDG100, HDG223, HDG208, TTE R178, TTE R120, D9.0 TTE, D7.0 TTE, D28.1 TTE) and is marked uncertain where typography required decoding.
Note RWY04/34R/34L: 5.0% climb gradient required up to 700FT. RWY05: 5.0% climb gradient required up to 1000FT.
VISIP is shown as D28.1 TTE. Coordinates for VISIP are not published on this chart and are not invented here.
Published heading and radial values are recorded as printed (HDG / VOR radial). Whether they are magnetic is not restated in recoverable text; they are not converted to true.

runwayGroups.narrative: Climb RWY HDG to 700FT, turn right HDG100° to TTE 9.0DME, turn right HDG223° to intercept and proceed via TTE R178 to VISIP. Cross TTE R120 at or above 5000FT, cross VISIP at or above 9000FT.
Climb RWY HDG to TTE 7.0DME, turn right HDG208° to intercept and proceed via TTE R178 to VISIP. Cross VISIP at or above 9000FT.
Climb RWY HDG to 1000FT, turn right HDG100° to TTE 9.0DME, turn right HDG223° to intercept and proceed via TTE R178 to VISIP. Cross TTE R120 at or above 5000FT, cross VISIP at or above 9000FT.

navaidsOnChart.note: Coordinates transcribed from a symbol-font line on the VISIP chart (decoded as 35°33'36"N / 139°45'54"E). Seconds have no tenths on the chart text.

crossCheck.coordinateDuplicates: All 53 table coordinates are unique per identifier and identical on every chart page that lists them.
